text: In the real jaffle shop seed data, raw_payments amount is stored in cents, not dollars. 2691 means 26 dollars and 91 cents. Every place this project displays a dollar figure needs that same conversion, consistently.
That's exactly the case worth writing a macro once for, instead of copy-pasting a bare round amount divided by 100 into every model that touches money.

Macro opens the definition, names it cents_to_dollars, declares column_name and a decimal_places argument defaulting to 2. Endmacro closes it. The rendered text is the output — no explicit return needed.

Called from the payments staging model specifically, applied as early as possible, so every downstream model — including fct_orders and the Power BI pages built on top of it — already receives dollars, not cents.
Next lesson: adding tests across the new models — not_null, unique, and a relationships test tying orders back to the customers mart.
